Naaman, second Kings 5. A great soldier had a hard sickness, and a captured girl pointed him to a prophet. Pride almost stopped him, but in the end he did a simple, humble thing, dipping in a river, and God made him clean. God sometimes chooses small steps on purpose, to show our trust is in Him, not a show. If His path looks too plain, that does not make it too small. Obey, and see His mercy.
